title: Supervisor internal reviewer rollout runbook
before_enablement: Verify runtime revision and exactly one expected backend listener.
Verify migrations through 013 and the current frontend build.
Configure one or two explicit reviewer IDs without committing them.
Verify owned-job allow and cross-owner denial.
Keep auto review and auto remap false.
Confirm batch, timeout, concurrency, and correction limits.
Configure provider credentials without logging secrets.
Verify backend kill switches and rollback owner.
Verify read-only audit export and zero safety counters.
after_enablement: Verify capabilities as one allowlisted reviewer.
Verify an allowlisted reviewer receives 404 for another user's job.
Request one read-only plan and verify zero provider calls.
Run one explicit single-row live Supervisor review.
Optionally run one naturally eligible guided remap.
Verify audit records, queue refresh, and zero mapping mutations.

failure_response.supervisor_unavailable: Preserve original suggestion, persist/display failure, continue manual review, retry only by later explicit action.
failure_response.mapper_unavailable: Preserve original suggestion and Supervisor review, persist/display failed revision, continue manual review.
failure_response.provider_timeout: No uncontrolled retry or automatic correction; preserve human review and allow only policy-permitted explicit retry.
failure_response.invalid_structured_response: Fail closed, produce no executable mapping, preserve human review.

reviewer_guidance: Supervisor eligible means second advisory review is justified; it does not mean the mapping is wrong.
High priority means review first; it does not mean definitely wrong.
Supervisor decisions and guided revisions are advisory.
Every revised mapping requires human review.
Never accept solely because a result looks safe or confident.
